sources.title: LAMMPS thermostat guidance
sources.scope: 查證具名案例與原理背景。課內數值、故障資料與判準為原創教學假設；請勿當作廠商規格或操作程序。
sources.scopeEn: Establish named case and principle context. Numbers, fault data, and criteria are original teaching assumptions, not manufacturer specifications or operating procedures.

related.title: NAMD：複本交換的詳細平衡與隨機接受證據
related.titleEn: NAMD: replica-exchange detailed balance and acceptance evidence
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：群組、動能與自由度一一對應；不能把單步溫度當作平衡統計證明。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Group, energy and degrees of freedom agree; a single temperature sample does not prove equilibrium statistics.
related.difference: 使用原創合成資料研究「NAMD：複本交換的詳細平衡與隨機接受證據」，從物理或資料契約推導計算，並以反例驗證。完成：交付權重推導、兩組接受事件、隨機種子與交換前後狀態對照表。
related.differenceEn: Investigate NAMD: replica-exchange detailed balance and acceptance evidence using an original synthetic fixture. Derive the calculation from its physical or data contract, challenge it with a counterexample, and defend a bounded conclusion. Complete: Deliver the weight-ratio derivation, both acceptance events, random-stream identifiers and a before-and-after replica-state table that separates temperature labels from physical configurations.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 將已去質心的 K=18 代入公式；同時計算錯用 f=12 的結果，解釋 3 與 4 的差異源於定義。
計算 exp(−1)，在零到一的線上標記接受區間與 u=0.5；將機率與一次事件分開記錄。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Insert unbiased K=18 into the temperature formula. Also compute the deliberately incorrect result obtained with twelve degrees of freedom and explain why the discrepancy is caused by inconsistent definitions rather than an integration failure.

Calculate exp(-1), mark its acceptance interval on a unit line and place u=0.5 on the same line. Record the probability separately from the realized decision so that one event is not confused with an estimated rate.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: CESM/CIME：耦合器通量的面積守恆帳本
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：群組、動能與自由度一一對應；不能把單步溫度當作平衡統計證明。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Group, energy and degrees of freedom agree; a single temperature sample does not prove equilibrium statistics.
related.difference: 使用原創合成資料研究「CESM/CIME：耦合器通量的面積守恆帳本」，從物理或資料契約推導計算，並以反例驗證。完成：交付面元功率表、方向定義、重映射權重檢查及時間積分收支。
related.differenceEn: Investigate CESM/CIME: area-conservative coupler flux accounting using an original synthetic fixture. Derive the calculation from its physical or data contract, challenge it with a counterexample, and defend a bounded conclusion. Complete: Deliver face-power tables, sign definitions, remapping-weight checks and a time-integrated budget that identifies every included and excluded energy pathway.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 將已去質心的 K=18 代入公式；同時計算錯用 f=12 的結果，解釋 3 與 4 的差異源於定義。
逐面計算二乘十及三乘二十，再相加；用五平方米與正確加權平均十六交叉核對。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Insert unbiased K=18 into the temperature formula. Also compute the deliberately incorrect result obtained with twelve degrees of freedom and explain why the discrepancy is caused by inconsistent definitions rather than an integration failure.
Compute each face contribution and sum them. Cross-check using total area five and weighted mean flux sixteen, distinguishing the weighted mean from the unweighted mean of the two input values.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
